According to NCERT principles for Revolt of 1857: Patterns and Representations (Royal Proclamation):

1. Queen Victoria's Proclamation, read out by Lord Canning at Allahabad on 1 November 1858, assured princely rulers that their territories would not be annexed and promised religious non-interference.
